defect.description: The new condition is not valid Python: `!` is not a negation operator (it should be `not hmac.compare_digest(...)`), so src/auth.py raises SyntaxError on import and every caller and test of is_authorized breaks.

review_items: src/auth.py:16 — `!` is not valid Python negation; module raises SyntaxError on import
src/auth.py:16 — `or` short-circuits, leaking whether the username matched via timing
src/auth.py:16 — pre-existing: compare_digest leaks secret length via timing
tests/test_auth.py — nit: no test verifies the constant-time property
votes.evidence_quote: Lines 16–17 use `!hmac.compare_digest(...)` — `!` does not exist in Python; the correct keyword is `not`. Any import of `src.auth` raises `SyntaxError` at parse time, so the module is entirely unusable and no admin endpoint can be reached.
votes.justification: The first finding names the exact defect. `!` is not a valid Python negation operator, it should be `not`, and the result is a SyntaxError on import of src/auth.py. That is the right location and the right consequence.
